'''Ivaar Workan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] who served on the ruling [[Circle of Lords]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]].

==Biography==
Circa [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]], Workan participated in an [[Skirmish near Eriadu|ambush]] on a [[Damorian Manufacturing Corporation/Legends|Damorian]] [[s18 light freighter]]. By [[44 ABY]], he had been elevated to the position of [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] in the [[Circle of Lords]] following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Sarasu Taalon]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], as part of the Lost Tribe's plan to take over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Workan infiltrated the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the guise of '''Kameron Suldar'''. As Suldar, he pretended to be a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented the planet [[B'nish]] in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance's]] [[Galactic Alliance Senate|Senate]], and in this guise, he was offered to enter the [[Lecersen Conspiracy]], but seeing the conspirators as a menace for the Sith he contributed to their downfall. On [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Workan was part of the Sith network [[BAMR News|BAMR]] that spread [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jedi]] propaganda. As Senator Suldar, he nominated [[Padnel Ovin]] as a candidate for Chief of State following the fragmentation of the ruling Triumvirate. Later, after [[Abeloth]] revealed herself to have infiltrated the Senate as Senator [[Rokari Kem]] and killed [[Grand Lord]] Vol, he nominated her to replace Ovin and was in turn made [[Chair of the Senate/Legends|Chair of the Senate]]. Later during the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|re-invasion]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] he [[Duel in Kameron Suldar's office|fought]] with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] team and was shot to [[Death/Legends|death]] by [[Ben Skywalker]].
